label: Ludwig Wittgenstein, Logisch-philosophische…: Tractatus 6.522: there is indeed the inexpressible…
interpretation: 6.522: 'Es gibt allerdings Unaussprechliches. Dies zeigt sich, es ist das Mystische.' Recorded literally; the traditional and resolute readings (DISAMB-TLP-NONSENSE) disagree on whether this asserts that there is something unsayable.
attribution: The passage states that there is indeed the inexpressible, which shows itself and is the mystical, which is the premise read literally.
